rows.grounds: technical term for a combined unit or mass

items.question: Under what combination of elements is an aggregate designated a piṇḍa?
premises: An aggregate may be joined by two elements.
An aggregate may alternatively be joined by many elements.
Such a joined combination receives a specific designation.
items.inference: Therefore, a combination of two or more elements is called a piṇḍa.
uncertainties: The specific nature of the elements being combined is supplied by the preceding context.
items.plain_english: When joined by two or by many, it is indeed called a piṇḍa.
